protocol.status: frozen 2026-11-19 for the notification-capable Glance Go; run on Juan PC (4 vCPU / 6 GiB VM)
protocol.scope: Glance Python API/catalog/bytes versus Go with the same matrix as v3; Python notifications noop (as v3), Go sends its notifications (messagingv2 to the same RabbitMQ and exchange as the original); Python image cache retained; Placement Python fixed
protocol.predecessor: glance-compact-v3 accepted at d3286a6 (Paolo hardware); v4 reruns it on the optimized code
protocol.acceptance: All 108 windows valid for this reduced scope; hashes, lengths, state, resource sampling, cleanup and original restoration verified; no minimum speedup required
protocol.purpose: Formal rerun after optimizations, deadlock retry and notifications; Go carries the notification work, Python does not
protocol.log_policy: Bound VM operational logs; rotate only outside measured windows, retain recent incident diagnostics and all benchmark samples
protocol.statistics: Three independent paired repetitions; publish individual results, median and range, declare limited uncertainty; no claim of precise tail or statistical significance
protocol.reason: v3 keeps Python noop because stock messagingv2 with CacheFilter exhausted LimitNOFILE in v2. v4 keeps that and additionally enables Go notifications, so Go does strictly more work than Python. Not comparable in absolute values with v3 (different hardware).

limitations: Notification policy: Python noop, Go original; Python without bus notifications (v3/v4); does not validate stock messagingv2 stability
Three independent paired repetitions per cell; median and observed range, no statistical significance claim
Closed-loop complete cycles including drain; upload cycle includes create/verify/delete and is not pure PUT throughput
Download checks every full payload; upload load verifies active metadata/hash, worker canaries round-trip outside measured windows
Public Apache path fixed; Python caches/workers/shared DB differ from Go isolated DB/store; no language-only attribution
Python soft-delete tombstones are retained; only owned blobs and active metadata deleted via API, no SQL purge
CPU/op uses all correct contract requests in common sample interval, including verification/404; PSS at1Hz, observed peak
Per-operation percentiles preserve mixed-cycle meaning; n=3 boot or joint performance not measured here
